name: Piyo Piyo ~Love Love Hobo-san~
original_name: ぴよピヨ～らぶらぶ保母さん～
source:
Main character is busy helping out with his father's pet shop. One day shop is visited by school director who intends to lend pets for children emotional education. Protagonist starts to bring pets to students with emotional problems. Can he find love among them?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公忙着在父亲的宠物店帮忙。某天，学校校长前来，打算借用宠物协助儿童的情感教育。主人公开始把宠物带给有情绪问题的学生。他能在其中找到爱情吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
